LanguageData.Miho_Apparel_Under_AssassinMelee.descrip:
The Asura Assassination Suit is a close combat mobile assassination suit. 

When wearing the Asura assassination suit, the mechanites inside the body react to make the body more nimble. 

Amulets attached to clothing diffuse the wearer's damage.
LanguageData.Miho_Apparel_Under_AssassinRanged.label: 美狐 Supreme 女巫 Robe
LanguageData.Miho_Apparel_Under_AssassinRanged.descri:
The Supreme Sorceress Robe is the perfect superpower booster. 
\When you wear the Supreme Sorceress Robe, you can create a strong force field that can project long-distance attacks.

In addition, it is a synthetic glove made of plastic and ebon silk, which boasts excellent protection performance.
